full_name: Viet Thanh Nguyen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2008–2009 Humanities Suzanne Young Murray Fellow University of Southern California
bio: Viet Thanh Nguyen's current research is a comparative study of how Vietnamese and Americans have remembered and represented the American war in Viet Nam, particularly through the arts.
